text: The attached report presents the activities undertaken by Toronto Atmospheric Fund in keeping with the 2020 Business Plan, the outcomes achieved, and reflections on challenges encountered and lessons learned.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s 2020 Accomplishments Report - Attachment 1 to the report (January 22, 2021) from the Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships for information.
